## Install

1. Download **FlashEdit.zip** below and double-click it.
2. Drag **FlashEdit.app** into your Applications folder.
3. Open it. The app isn't notarized by Apple yet, so the first time macOS says it can't verify it:
   open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click **Open Anyway**.
   (Or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/FlashEdit.app` once in Terminal.)

Requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later, on Apple silicon or Intel. Chat editing uses your local
[Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) CLI if it's installed; everything else works offline.
